subject: Marketplace onboarding: PO & vendor intake — AWS/Azure/GCP next steps
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmesoftware.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurements@acmesoftware.com
Date: 2028-06-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: Marketplace onboarding: PO path questions

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. We want to get the ball rolling on listing Redwood Inference in the Acme marketplace channels (AWS & Azure first, GCP later). Procurement asked me to confirm the exact PO flow for each marketplace so they can finalize routing and ERP mapping. Specifically: 

- Will Acme issue a single consolidated PO that covers hosted API usage and a separate PO for Dedicated/Private?
- For AWS Marketplace, do we need a separate Seller PO or is the standard Acme PO sufficient?
- Required fields on the PO (billing contact, Redwood tax ID/Remit address, marketplace listing ID) — can you send a sample PO acceptance template?

I attached our internal procurement profile to help (Acme_procurement_profile.pdf). Can you loop in whoever owns marketplace billing on your side? We want to avoid rework once legal sends the SOW.

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Head of Procurement, Acme Software
procurements@acmesoftware.com

Attachment: Acme_procurement_profile.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmesoftware.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: PO path questions

Hi Alex —

Great to hear — thanks for the profile. Quick answers and next steps below. I’m copying Vanessa (Marketplaces) and Kimberly (Finance) so we have PO routing & tax accounted for.

Short answers: 
- Consolidated PO: Acme can submit one master PO referencing the listing(s). We typically map a single PO to hosted API consumption. Dedicated/Private deployments normally require a separate contract/reserved capacity order (we can treat that as a linked PO).
- AWS Marketplace: For AMI/PrivateListing offerings we need the Seller ID and an AWS Marketplace order reference. Some customers prefer to route through AWS (AWS invoicing) — others prefer to issue directly to Redwood. We support both; the main difference is where the invoice lands (AWS vs Redwood Billing).
- Required PO fields: PO number, billing contact, billing email, Redwood remit address (see below), Redwood tax ID (EIN: 12-3456789), marketplace listing ID (if available), start/end dates or "open-ended" billing.

Action items for Acme:
1) Please complete our vendor intake form (attached) and the W-9 equivalent for tax (if US).
2) Share the Acme AP contact and your ERP PO routing code (e.g., GL code).
3) If you want AWS invoicing, confirm the Seller routing preference and provide the AWS account number.

I attached the vendor intake form and a short checklist for marketplace POs (RI_vendor_intake_form_filled.pdf, AWS_listing_requirements.xlsx). Vanessa — can you add the standard PO acceptance template and confirm net-terms mapping (Net30 vs AWS immediate invoice)?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Marketplaces, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachments: RI_vendor_intake_form_filled.pdf (application/pdf), AWS_listing_requirements.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Thanks for bringing this up — adding details from the Marketplace ops side so Acme’s AP team has everything they need.

Marketplace PO routing summary (practical checklist):
- AWS Marketplace (Metered/PrivateListing): usual flow is AWS invoices Acme and pays the seller; if Acme wants Redwood invoices directly we need a PO that references the Redwood seller contract + listing ID.
- Azure Marketplace: typically requires a vendor invoice to Redwood with the Azure listing reference; Azure will also surface a Marketplace transaction ID.
- GCP Marketplace: similar to Azure but ask for the subscription id & billing project id.

Required fields on PO (copy/paste checklist):
- PO number (mandatory)
- Billing contact name & email
- Billing address: Redwood Inference, 1201 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103
- Remit: Redwood Inference, 1201 Market St, SF, CA 94103
- Redwood EIN: 12-3456789
- Marketplace listing ID(s) or SKU(s) 
- Start date / Term or "Indefinite" and renewal cadence
- For Reserved/Dedicated: attach the Dedicated SOW reference or the reserved capacity order number

PO acceptance template: Kimberly, can you attach the latest PO acceptance template? Also confirm whether we can accept PO without a signed SOW for Hosted API up to $25k ARR (finance tolerance).

Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
